question: What description is declared of her as discus-bearer who is one-footed and three-eyed?
premises: This verse declares her by several epithets.
She is said to be a discus-bearer.
She is described as one-footed and three-eyed.
inference: She is declared as the discus-bearer, one-footed and three-eyed.
plain_english: She is said to be the discus-bearer, one-footed, and three-eyed.
